name: Runner Extras - Negated Exist FlowField
brief: Issue #2294: a Boolean FlowField with CalcFormula = -exist(...) threw InvalidCastException (NavBoolean -> NavBigInteger) inside NCLMetaCalculationFormula.NegateValue, and CalcFields answered false.
description: The runner routed every negated CalcFormula through BC's NCLMetaCalculationFormula.NegateValue, which switches on the SOURCE field's NavType and only knows Decimal/BigInteger/Integer. BC itself never calls it for exist: FlowFieldsHelper.CalcExistsAsync answers NavBoolean.Create(!exists) when NegateResult is set, and CalcCountAsync negates the raw count. This suite proves the Base Application field Item."Cost is Posted to G/L" (CalcFormula = -exist("Post Value Entry to G/L" where("Item No." = field("No.")))) calculates: CalcFields returns true, the field is true with no matching row and false with one. The oracle values were measured on a real BC 28.1 service tier in the issue; the plain-BC claim belongs upstream in the corpus.
